verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Ubuntu ships with access to a large catalog of applications (thousands of apps, including named popular apps like Firefox, Chrome, Discord, Steam, OBS Studio), implying an app-store style ecosystem, but no evidence explicitly names the built-in app store (e.g., Ubuntu Software/App Center) or describes a single-click install flow or UX for switchers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the app store interface, one-click install workflow, and independent/hands-on confirmation of ease-of-use for a switcher persona.
